posts.zh:
dsh-worlds 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。通过提供 `ctx.fs` 与 `ctx.subprocess` 接缝，把 agent 的文件系统、bash 与 PTY 终端跑在 Docker 容器里；工作目录、环境变量与后台进程可在 harness 重启后存活。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e5f7437cf48c371df45d.html
posts.en:
dsh-worlds is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Runs the agent's filesystem, bash and PTY terminals inside a Docker container by providing the `ctx.fs` and `ctx.subprocess` seams, so cwd, environment and background processes survive a harness restart.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e5f7437cf48c371df45d.html
